14	#include "db/common/global_resource.h"
15	#include <mutex>
16	#include <zvec/ailego/buffer/block_eviction_queue.h>
17	#include <zvec/db/config.h>
18	
19	namespace zvec {
20	
21	void GlobalResource::initialize() {
22	  static std::once_flag flag;
23	  std::call_once(flag, [this]() {
24	    this->query_thread_pool_.reset(new ailego::ThreadPool(
25	        GlobalConfig::Instance().query_thread_count(),
26	        GlobalConfig::Instance().query_thread_binding()));
27	    this->optimize_thread_pool_.reset(new ailego::ThreadPool(
28	        GlobalConfig::Instance().optimize_thread_count(),
29	        GlobalConfig::Instance().optimize_thread_binding()));
30	    zvec::ailego::MemoryLimitPool::get_instance().init(
31	        GlobalConfig::Instance().memory_limit_bytes());
32	  });
33	}
34	
35	}  // namespace zvec
36
